summary: Radar for 2026-11-23 (Thanksgiving is in 3 days). Two fresh hooks in this batch fit the "broad searched question" rule that the playbook says drives discovery. (1) An umbrella review of meta-analyses on GLP-1s and cancer (Cancer Epidemiol, 20 Nov), plus the 48-RCT meta-analysis in Ann Intern Med, refreshes the large evergreen search "does Mounjaro cause cancer / thyroid cancer warning". It makes a calm, label-anchored long video. (2) Retatrutide's TRIUMPH knee-osteoarthritis results (about 2/3 had knee pain cut in half; ScienceDaily 19 Nov, Healio, MNT) are spreading into mainstream health news. Retatrutide is unapproved, so this is caution only: a Short or a chapter in a broad "weight loss and joint pain" video, never a "What is retatrutide" video. The EloraTZP Phase 2b (up to 23.3% vs 14.8% on tirzepatide alone; Phase 3 starting Q4) is still the channel's biggest earner. A refresh update linked to the original fits the fast-turn rule only if new Phase 3 news lands. Otherwise it's a description link, not a new video. The Zepbound vs Wegovy HD analysis is indirect (SURMOUNT-1 vs STEP UP), and it lost significance in the efficacy analysis. Use it only as a caveated chapter. The Zepbound vs Wegovy long video is already live (11-21), so don't re-produce it. The required search-demand formats are covered below: vial vs pen how-to (IFU), a first-year timeline, the NAION label change, SURMOUNT-5 head-to-head, and hair loss / nausea / injection-site felt symptoms. Holiday-table Shorts peak 24–27 Nov. Rejected: the brand-funded prebiotic soda pilot (OLIPOP, n=80) as a topic, pricing and access stories, aspiration before surgery (surgery is banned in Shorts), and pediatric semaglutide as a long video (wrong audience). Sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43063527/, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41359966/, https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261118065534.htm, https://www.healio.com/news/rheumatology/20261111/speaker-weight-loss-with-retatrutide-signals-new-days-for-knee-osteoarthritis-care, https://www.hcplive.com/view/easd-2026-eloratzp-bests-tirzepatide-on-weight-loss-a1c-in-type-2-diabetes, https://www.rttnews.com/3694892/lilly-zepbound-shows-greater-weight-loss-than-wegovy-hd-in-new-analysis.aspx, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07744360

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) and cancer: what the evidence actually shows (new umbrella review of meta-analyses, Nov 20; the 48-RCT meta-analysis; the label's thyroid C-cell warning explained)
candidates.angle: Broad long video: 'Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) and Cancer: What Do Studies Show?' Calm and reassuring, never dismissive. Randomized trials show little or no effect on obesity-related, thyroid, pancreatic or breast cancer. Observational studies hint at lower risk but carry confounding (cite the 'Laundered Survival' critique as the honesty beat). Then the label's boxed warning in plain words: rodent findings, and who shouldn't use it (personal or family history of MTC or MEN 2). Then questions to bring to your prescriber.
candidates.predicted_peak: evergreen with a 1–3 week refresh window
candidates.why_now: A fresh umbrella review of meta-analyses (Cancer Epidemiol, 20 Nov) and a J Clin Epidemiol critique (20 Nov) give a new hook to a large, steady fear-driven search. Most creator coverage is scary or outdated. A broad searched question, which fits this week's playbook.
